name: FV3-GFS replay dataset and analysis increments
model_or_instrument: NOAA FV3-GFS replayed to ECMWF IFS operational analysis
resolution: C192 (≈50 km) horizontal, 127 vertical levels, reduced to T21 (64x32) for training

scales.note: FV3-GFS run at C192 (≈50 km) and reduced to T21 (~625 km, 64x32 grid) for training; 6-hourly replay increments over 15 months (20 Nov 2019 to 1 Mar 2021 = 456 days).
